Water splitting aur oxygen release connected events hain; inka detailed mechanism aage kholenge.
ATP aur NADPH kyun banane hain?
Dekho, ATP usable energy aur NADPH reducing power supply karta hai, isliye captured light baad ki sugar synthesis ke kaam aa sakti hai.
points.screen: Realistic chloroplast cutaway mein thylakoid membrane highlighted; paas chaar simple event tiles: light absorption, water splitting, O₂ release, ATP + NADPH formation.

says: Yeh events several protein complexes ki madad se chalte hain; complex mein molecules ek organised working group banate hain.
Photosystem light collect karne aur photochemical event shuru karne wali pigment–protein unit hai.
Do distinct units hain: Photosystem I, ya PS I, aur Photosystem II, ya PS II.
Inmein light harvesting complexes pigments aur proteins ki light-collecting teams hain.
Kya PS I ka naam functioning mein pehle aane ka proof hai?
Aksar log sochte hain ki PS I pehle function karta hai, par asal mein I aur II discovery ka order batate hain, functioning ka nahi.
Actual electron route ko hum agle heading mein dekhenge.
points.screen: Usi thylakoid membrane ka molecular zoom: do separate pigment–protein units PS I aur PS II, dono mein light harvesting complex region highlighted; discovery-order tag dono names se linked.

terms.meaning: Light collect karke photochemical electron transfer shuru karne wali organised pigment–protein unit.
Photosystems mein light collect karne wale protein-bound pigments ke groups.

points.outside_book: Protein complex ko organised molecular working group ke roop mein briefly clarify kiya.

says: Ek light harvesting complex mein hundreds of pigment molecules proteins se bound hote hain.
Photosystem ke collecting pigments milkar antennae banate hain, yaani light-harvesting pigment network.
Is collecting network se special reaction-centre chlorophyll a ko alag pehchaano; reaction centre woh site hai jahaan excitation electron transfer shuru karati hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki chlorophyll a sirf reaction centre mein hota hai, par asal mein antenna mein bhi chlorophyll a ke saath doosre pigments hote hain.
Itne pigments saath hone se efficiency kyun badhti hai?
Dekho, different pigments different wavelengths capture karte hain, aur pehle samjha accessory-pigment energy transfer us collection ko reaction centre tak pahunchata hai.
points.screen: Ek photosystem ka wahi molecular view: protein scaffold par many antenna pigments; unse alag reaction-centre chlorophyll a site; selected coloured light beams collecting pigments tak.

terms.meaning: Photosystem ka protein-bound pigment network jo light collect karke excitation energy reaction centre tak pahunchata hai.
Photosystem ki special chlorophyll a site jahaan excitation se electron donation shuru hota hai.

points.outside_book: Reaction centre ka functional meaning figure se pehle khola; antenna mein bhi chlorophyll a ki presence clarify ki.

says: Socho, chhat par ek badi collector dish weak incoming signal ko apni broad surface se collect karti hai.
Dish ka arrangement signal ko ek focal detector tak concentrate karta hai, jahaan useful electrical response shuru hota hai.
Badi collecting surface aur chhota detector alag jobs kyun kar rahe hain?
Dekho, broad collector signal pakadne ka chance badhata hai, jabki detector collected signal ko agle useful event mein badalta hai.
Yahaan dish antenna pigments ka network hai, focal detector reaction centre hai, aur signal ka focus hona excitation energy ka reaction centre tak pahunchna hai.
points.screen: Collector dish se focal detector tak converging signal paths; saath photosystem ke antenna se reaction centre tak matching energy paths.
points.outside_book: Collector dish aur focal detector ka everyday analogy add kiya.
points.answer: Dish antenna pigment network ko, focal detector reaction centre ko, aur converging signal excitation-energy transfer ko represent karta hai.
points.watch_out: Pigments actual dish ki tarah light reflect karke focus nahi karte; absorbed excitation energy molecular interactions se transfer hoti hai.

says: Figure 11.4, light harvesting complex, mein Photon label se shuru karo: photon light energy ka ek packet hai, jo peripheral pigment par aata hai.
Pigment molecules label collecting cluster ko identify karta hai.
Red zigzag route absorbed excitation energy ko pigments ke through Reaction centre tak jaate dikhata hai.
Excitation energy ka matlab light absorption se mili extra energy hai.
Reaction centre se upward blue arrow Primary acceptor tak electron donation dikhata hai; primary acceptor reaction centre ka electron sabse pehle leta hai.
Kya zigzag aur blue arrow ek hi cheez ka transfer dikhate hain?
Dekho, zigzag antenna mein excitation-energy transfer hai, jabki blue arrow reaction centre se acceptor ko electron transfer hai.
Electron donation se donor aur acceptor par alag charges bante hain; is charge separation se light capture ek chemical event se judta hai.
points.screen: Figure 11.4 ke labels Photon, Pigment molecules, Reaction centre, Primary acceptor sequentially highlighted; red excitation route aur blue electron arrow distinctly traced.

terms.meaning: Light energy ka ek packet.
Light absorb hone par pigment ko mili extra energy.
Reaction centre se donate hua electron sabse pehle receive karne wala molecule.
Electron transfer ke baad donor aur acceptor par alag electrical charges ka banna.

points.outside_book: Photon, excitation energy aur charge separation ke basic meanings electron-transfer figure samajhne ke liye add kiye.

says: Ab isi complex mein chlorophyll b ke ek peripheral molecule par absorbed photon follow karo.
Us absorption ki excitation energy antenna network ke through special chlorophyll a reaction centre tak pahunchti hai.
Uske baad acceptor ko electron kaun deta hai?
Dekho, reaction-centre chlorophyll a electron donate karta hai; peripheral chlorophyll b ki role yahaan energy collect karke centre tak pahunchane ki thi.
Is ek event mein photon ki energy ka contribution aur reaction centre se nikle electron ka route alag pehchaan mein aa gaya.
points.screen: Wahi photosystem view: ek chlorophyll b molecule highlighted; energy pulse network se centre tak, phir alag electron marker centre se acceptor tak.
points.outside_book: Figure ke generic peripheral pigment ko chlorophyll b maan kar ek concrete worked event follow kiya.

says: Dono photosystems ke special reaction centres ko ab unki characteristic absorption wavelengths se pehchaanenge.
Absorption peak woh wavelength hai jahaan absorption maximum hota hai; nm ki unit hum pehle khol chuke hain.
PS I ka centre 700 nm peak ke kaaran P700, aur PS II ka centre 680 nm maximum ke kaaran P680 kehlaata hai.
Kya alag peak names ka matlab alag pigment types hain?

says: Pichhli baar humne electron ke do raaste dekhe, cyclic aur non-cyclic. Aapne dekha ki dono raaston mein ATP banta hai.
Par ek baat aapko ajeeb lagegi. Electron toh carriers ke beech hi daudta raha, ADP ko usne kabhi chhooa hi nahi.
Toh aaj ka sawaal yeh hai ki electron ki yeh daud ATP kaise bana deti hai?
Is sawaal ka jawab ek vichaar deta hai, jise aaj hum dheere-dheere kholenge.
Pehle H⁺ ko yaad karo. Yeh positive charge wala hydrogen ion hai, jise proton bhi kehte hain.
Ab ek phoola hua gubbara socho. Uske andar hawa zyada hai aur bahar kam, isliye munh khulte hi hawa tezi se bahar bhaagti hai.
Kisi cheez ki maatra ek taraf zyada ho aur doosri taraf kam. Is fark ko hum gradient kehte hain. Isi tarah membrane ke dono taraf H⁺ ki maatra ke fark ko proton gradient kehte hain.

Ab hum us vichaar par lautte hain. Yaad karo, Priestley ne bhi pehle ek vichaar rakha tha. Unka vichaar tha ki plants hawa ki ghati hui cheez phir bhar dete hain, aur baad ke experiments ne use jaancha.
Aisa vichaar pehle samjhaane ke liye rakha jaata hai, aur phir experiments se jaancha jaata hai. Aise vichaar ko hum hypothesis kehte hain.
Is vichaar ke naam ka pehla shabd chemiosmotic hai, jo do hisson se bana hai. Chemi yaani chemical kaam, yahan ATP banne ki reaction, aur osmotic yaani membrane ke aar-paar cheezon ka jaana.
Toh chemiosmotic hypothesis humein batati hai ki chloroplast mein ATP asal mein kaise banta hai. Iske hisaab se ATP banna membrane ke aar-paar H⁺ ke fark se juda hai.
Yeh vichaar Peter Mitchell ne 1961 mein diya tha. Iske liye unhe 1978 mein Chemistry ka Nobel Prize mila.
Aap aage dekhoge ki respiration mein bhi ATP isi tarah banta hai. Photosynthesis mein bhi ATP banna membrane ke aar-paar proton gradient banne se juda hai.
Yahan woh membrane thylakoid ki membrane hai. Yaad karo, thylakoid ek chapti thaili hai. Uski deewaar membrane hai, andar ki jagah lumen, aur bahar ka fluid stroma.
Chloroplast mein ek fark hai: yahan H⁺ membrane ke andar ki taraf, yaani lumen mein, jama hote hain.
Ab respiration ki jagah dekho, yaani mitochondria. Mitochondria ki do membranes hoti hain, ek bahar wali aur ek andar wali.
Inter ka matlab hai beech. Dono membranes ke beech ki patli jagah ko intermembrane space kehte hain.
Humne dekha ki chloroplast mein H⁺ sabse andar wali jagah, lumen, mein jama hote hain. Toh kya mitochondria mein bhi H⁺ sabse andar wali jagah mein hi jama hote hain?

Nahi, mitochondria mein H⁺ sabse andar wali jagah mein jama nahi hote. Respiration mein electrons ETS, yaani electron transport system, se guzarte hain. Tab H⁺ isi intermembrane space mein jama hote hain.
Us sabse andar wali jagah ko aage hum matrix kahenge.
Respiration ka yeh hissa aap aage respiration padhte waqt khologe. Abhi itna yaad rakho: chloroplast mein lumen, aur mitochondria mein intermembrane space.
points.screen: Zoom from a green leaf into a chloroplast and onto one thylakoid sac cut open: its membrane wall, the lumen inside, the stroma outside. Beside it an inflated balloon with more air inside than outside. A small recall card of Priestley's bell jar marks an idea put forward first and tested later; the word chemiosmotic splits into chemi (ATP-making reaction) and osmotic (crossing the membrane). Then a mitochondrion cut open: outer and inner membranes, H⁺ dots gathering in the thin intermembrane space and none in the innermost space. Two tags settle: chloroplast → lumen, mitochondria → intermembrane space.

terms.meaning: Ek taraf kisi cheez ki maatra zyada aur doosri taraf kam hone ka fark.
Membrane ke dono taraf H⁺ ki maatra ka fark.
Pehle samjhaane ke liye rakha gaya vichaar, jise baad mein experiments se jaancha jaata hai.
Vichaar ki ATP banna membrane ke aar-paar H⁺ ke fark se juda hai; chemi = chemical kaam (ATP banna), osmotic = membrane ke aar-paar jaana.
Mitochondria ki do membranes ke beech ki patli jagah; inter = beech.
Electron transport system: electron aage dene wale carriers ki kadi.

points.outside_book: Phoole gubbare ki tasveer; hypothesis ka matlab Priestley ke pehle padhe vichaar se jodkar; chemiosmotic naam ke hisson ka matlab; Peter Mitchell ne yeh vichaar 1961 mein diya aur 1978 mein Chemistry ka Nobel Prize paaya; mitochondria ki sabse andar wali jagah ka naam matrix (respiration mein aage).
points.answer: Nahi, mitochondria mein H⁺ sabse andar wali jagah (matrix) mein nahi, dono membranes ke beech intermembrane space mein jama hote hain; chloroplast mein woh lumen mein jama hote hain.
points.watch_out: Chloroplast mein H⁺ lumen mein jama hote hain, stroma mein nahi; mitochondria mein intermembrane space mein, matrix mein nahi.

says: Is poore vichaar ko aap ek dam ki tasveer se samjho. Yeh tasveer aaj ke poore safar mein hamare saath rahegi.
Socho, nadi par ek oonchi deewaar bani hai, aur deewaar ke peeche bahut saara paani roka gaya hai.
Deewaar ke neeche wali nadi mein paani kam hai. Isliye peeche ka paani neeche bahne ke liye zor lagata rehta hai.
Deewaar mein bas ek nali chhodi gayi hai, aur us nali mein ek turbine lagi hai.
Aap dekhoge ki paani nali se girta hai toh turbine ghoomti hai. Turbine se juda generator bijli banata hai.
Jalaashay bhara rahe, isliye kuch pump bhi lage hain. Yeh pump neeche ka paani uthakar deewaar ke peeche chadha dete hain, aur inhe chalane mein energy lagti hai.
Ab dekho, kaun kya hai. Dam ki deewaar thylakoid membrane hai, aur deewaar ke peeche roka hua paani lumen mein jama H⁺ hain.
Neeche ki kam paani wali nadi stroma hai, jahan H⁺ kam hain.
Paani chadhane wale pump electron transport ke woh kaam hain, jo H⁺ ko lumen tak pahunchaate hain. In pumps ki energy light se aati hai.
Deewaar ki nali, turbine aur generator membrane mein lagi ek protein machine hai, aur bani hui bijli ATP hai.
Aap samajh gaye honge ki paani roke bina bijli nahi banti. Isi tarah H⁺ ko lumen mein roke bina ATP nahi banta.
points.screen: A photorealistic dam on a river: tall wall, full reservoir behind it, low river below, one pipe through the wall with a turbine and a generator, and pumps lifting water back up. Labels appear one by one over the scene: wall = thylakoid membrane, reservoir = lumen H⁺, river = stroma, pumps = electron transport steps, pipe + turbine + generator = protein machine, electricity = ATP.
points.outside_book: Dam, pump, turbine aur generator ki tasveer (teaching plan ka analogy).
points.answer: Dam ki deewaar = thylakoid membrane; deewaar ke peeche roka paani = lumen mein jama H⁺; neeche ki kam paani wali nadi = stroma (H⁺ kam); paani chadhane wale pump = electron transport ke H⁺ ko lumen tak pahunchaane wale kaam, jinki energy light se aati hai; nali, turbine aur generator = membrane mein lagi protein machine (ATP synthase); bani bijli = ATP.
points.watch_out: Dam ka paani gravity se girta hai, jabki H⁺ maatra aur charge ke fark se behte hain; machine bijli nahi, ATP molecule banati hai; aur water splitting ke H⁺ kisi pump se nahi, seedhe lumen mein hi bante hain.

says: Dam mein pehle jalaashay bharna padta hai, tabhi turbine ghoomti hai. Thylakoid mein bhi pehla kaam lumen mein H⁺ jama karna hai.
Toh chalo, pehle hum samjhein ki yeh proton gradient banta kaise hai.
Iske liye humein light reaction mein electron ka safar ek baar phir dekhna hoga.
Aap kahoge ki electron ka yeh safar toh hum pehle hi dekh chuke hain. Toh use dobara kyun dekhein?
Electron ka safar hum dobara isliye dekhenge, kyunki uske kuch kadam H⁺ ki ginti badal dete hain. Yeh ginti membrane ke dono taraf badalti hai.
Yaad karo, light milne par electron zyada energy wali state mein pahunch jaata hai, yaani excited ho jaata hai.
Light ki energy se electron ke is tarah jaag uthne ko activation of electrons kehte hain.
Phir excited electron ek carrier se doosre carrier ko aage diya jaata hai. Yahi uska transport hai.
Aaj ka poora kaam do hisson mein hai. Pehle gradient banta hai, aur phir gradient tootkar ATP banata hai.
Gradient banne ki aap teen wajahein dekhoge. Pehli, water splitting lumen mein H⁺ deti hai.
Doosri, ek carrier stroma se H⁺ uthakar lumen mein chhodta hai. Teesri, NADPH banne mein stroma ke H⁺ kharch hote hain.
Teeno ko hum Figure 11.7 par dekhenge, jo electron aur H⁺, dono ka safar ek saath dikhata hai.
points.screen: Back on the same realistic thylakoid section: light falls on the membrane, an electron glows (excited) and is handed from carrier to carrier. A two-step strip reads: gradient banna → gradient tootna. Three empty markers wait on the membrane for the three causes, still unlabelled.

terms.meaning: Light ki energy se electron ka excited hona, yaani zyada energy wali state mein pahunchna.

points.answer: Electron ka safar dobara isliye dekhte hain kyunki uske kuch kadam membrane ke dono taraf H⁺ ki ginti badalte hain, aur wahi proton gradient banaate hain.

says: Ab aap Figure 11.7 par ungli rakho. Yeh thylakoid ki band thaili ka ek hissa hai, jise kaatkar dikhaya gaya hai.
Dekho, gulaabi patti Thylakoid membrane hai. Isi mein photosystems, electron carriers aur ATP banane wali machine lagi hain.
Patti ke andar Lumen (high H⁺) likha hai, kyunki yahan H⁺ zyada jama hote hain. Bahar aap Stroma (low H⁺) padhoge, kyunki wahan H⁺ kam reh jaate hain.
Ab Light ke orange teer dekho. Ek teer P680 wale PS II par padta hai, aur doosra P700 wale PS I par. Yahan PS ka matlab photosystem hai.
Dekho, PS II ke paas H₂O se ½O₂ + H⁺ banta dikhaya hai. Saath mein Oxidation of water likha hai, kyunki paani yahan electron deta hai.
Par humne padha tha ki oxygen gas O₂ hai, jismein do atom jude hote hain. Toh yahan ½O₂ kyun likha hai?
½O₂ isliye likha hai, kyunki ek paani se oxygen ka ek hi atom milta hai, yaani aadha O₂ molecule. Do paani milkar ek poora O₂ dete hain.
Aap dekhoge ki yeh H⁺ lumen ki taraf dikhaya gaya hai. Paani ka electron PS II ki kami poori karta hai.
Chalo, ab hum electron ke saath chalte hain. PS II se electron PQ tak jaata hai, jiska poora naam Plastoquinone hai.
Plasto plastid se aaya hai, aur chloroplast ek plastid hi hai. Quinone carbon wale compounds ka ek parivaar hai, aur PQ membrane ke andar hi ghoomne wala carrier hai.
PQ ke paas stroma se aata H⁺ ka teer dekho. H⁺ lekar PQ ka naam PQH₂ ho jaata hai, aur H₂ yahan do hydrogen judne ko batata hai.
Iske aage Cytochrome B6f aata hai. Cytochromes ko hum electron lekar aage dene wale proteins jaante hain. Is complex ke andar cytochrome b6 aur cytochrome f hote hain.
B6f ke paas ek H⁺ ka teer lumen ki taraf jaata hai. Yaani carriers ke raaste stroma ke H⁺ lumen tak pahunch rahe hain, aur aap is teer ko yaad rakho.

B6f se electron PC tak jaata hai, yaani Plastocyanin tak, jo electron ko P700 wale PS I tak pahunchata hai. Yeh lumen ki taraf ka chhota protein hai, aur isme copper hota hai. Copper se yeh neela dikhta hai, aur cyan ka matlab neela hi hai.
Ab dekho, light paakar PS I electron ko stroma ki taraf Fd tak bhejta hai. Fd yaani ferredoxin, aur ferre iron ko batata hai, kyunki is protein mein iron hota hai.
Fd se electron FNR tak jaata hai. FNR ke paas NADP⁺ + H⁺ se NADPH banta dikhaya hai. FNR ka poora naam ferredoxin-NADP⁺ reductase hai, yaani wahi NADP reductase enzyme jise hum pehle jaan chuke hain.
Ab daayi taraf dekho. Membrane ke aar-paar ek machine lagi hai, jis par ATP synthase likha hai. Synthase ka matlab banane wala enzyme hai, toh yeh ATP banane wala enzyme hai.
Iska membrane mein dhansa hissa CF₀ hai, aur stroma ki taraf nikla sir CF₁ hai. CF₁ ke paas ADP + Pᵢ se ATP banta dikhaya hai.
Phir aap saare H⁺ labels gino: kuch lumen ke andar hain, kuch carriers ke paas, aur kuch hare teeron par. Yeh hare teer lumen ke H⁺ ko CF₀ aur CF₁ ke raaste stroma mein lautate hain.
Dekho, ek wedge bhi bana hai, yaani patla hota hua kona. Us par High Electrochemical Potential Gradient se Low tak likha hai.
Electrochemical shabd do hisson se bana hai: electro yaani charge ka fark, aur chemical yaani maatra ka fark.

Aap jaante ho ki lumen mein H⁺ zyada hain, aur H⁺ par positive charge hota hai. Isliye wahan maatra bhi zyada hai aur positive charge bhi. Isi wajah se High sira lumen mein aur Low sira stroma mein hai.
Yahan aap ek baat par gaur karo. Electron carriers se hota hua NADPH tak jaata hai, ADP tak kabhi nahi pahunchta, aur H⁺ alag teeron par chalte hain.
Membrane ke aar-paar H⁺ ke fark aur uske bahaav se ATP banne ko chemiosmosis kehte hain. Isiliye is figure ka naam ATP synthesis through chemiosmosis hai.
points.screen: Figure 11.7 on the same realistic thylakoid section, each label lighting as the finger reaches it: Thylakoid membrane; Lumen (high H⁺) inside and Stroma (low H⁺) outside; orange Light arrows to P680 PS II and P700 PS I; H₂O → ½O₂ + H⁺ with Oxidation of water, the ½O₂ label pulsing while two waters join into one O₂; PQ, PQH₂, Plastoquinone; Cytochrome B6f; PC, Plastocyanin; Fd; FNR with NADP⁺ + H⁺ → NADPH; ATP synthase with CF₀ in the membrane and CF₁ in the stroma, ADP + Pᵢ → ATP; the H⁺ labels and green return arrows; the High–Low wedge. The electron path glows in one colour, the H⁺ arrows in another.

terms.meaning: Membrane ke andar ghoomne wala carrier jo PS II se electron leta hai; plasto = plastid, quinone = carbon wale compounds ka parivaar.
H⁺ lekar bana PQ ka roop; H₂ = do hydrogen jude.
PQ aur PC ke beech ka protein complex, jismein cytochrome b6 aur cytochrome f hote hain.
Lumen ki taraf ka chhota copper wala neela protein jo electron PS I tak le jaata hai.
PS I ke baad stroma ki taraf ka iron wala electron carrier; ferre = iron.
Ferredoxin-NADP⁺ reductase, yaani NADP reductase enzyme.
H⁺ ki maatra (chemical) aur charge (electro), dono ka fark; lumen mein zyada, stroma mein kam.
Membrane ke aar-paar lagi ATP banane wali protein machine; synthase = banane wala enzyme.
Membrane ke aar-paar H⁺ ke fark aur uske bahaav se ATP banna.

points.outside_book: Figure ke naamon ke hisse aur unke kaam: plasto = plastid, quinone parivaar; cytochrome B6f mein cytochrome b6 aur f; plastocyanin mein copper aur uska neela rang (cyan); ferredoxin mein iron (ferre); FNR ka poora naam ferredoxin-NADP⁺ reductase; electrochemical = charge + maatra; synthase = banane wala enzyme; ½O₂ ka matlab ek paani se oxygen ka ek atom.
points.answer: ½O₂ isliye likha hai kyunki ek paani se oxygen ka ek hi atom milta hai; do paani milkar ek poora O₂ dete hain.
points.watch_out: Electron ka raasta (PS II → PQ → B6f → PC → PS I → Fd → FNR → NADP⁺) aur H⁺ ke teer alag hain; electron ADP tak kabhi nahi jaata, aur High sira lumen mein hai, stroma mein nahi.

says: Ab hum pehli wajah lete hain, yaani water splitting.
Yaad karo, water splitting PS II se judi hai. Uski machine membrane ke andar wale chehre par, lumen ki taraf lagi hai.
Wahan do paani ke molecules tootkar chaar H⁺, ek O₂ aur chaar electron dete hain.
Hydrogen atom mein ek proton aur ek electron hota hai, yeh aapne chemistry mein padha hai. Electron nikal jaaye toh sirf proton bachta hai.
Isliye hum H⁺ ko protons or hydrogen ions kehte hain. Chahe proton kaho ya hydrogen ion, dono ek hi kan ke naam hain.
Aap jaante ho ki gradient ke liye in H⁺ ko lumen mein jama hona hai. Toh kya inhe bhi kisi carrier ko membrane ke paar pahunchaana padta hai?
Nahi, in H⁺ ko kisi carrier ko membrane ke paar nahi pahunchaana padta. Paani lumen ki taraf hi tootta hai, isliye H⁺ seedhe lumen mein chhoot jaate hain.
Lumen chaaron taraf membrane se ghiri band thaili hai, isliye yeh H⁺ wahin jama hote jaate hain.
Dam ki tasveer mein socho, jaise jalaashay mein seedha barish ka paani gir raha ho. Use upar chadhane ke liye pump nahi chahiye.
Toh pehli wajah yeh hai ki water splitting membrane ki inner side par hoti hai. Isliye usse bane protons or hydrogen ions thylakoid ke lumen mein jama hote hain.
points.screen: Same thylakoid section, only the first marker lit: zoom on PS II's lumen-facing water-splitting site; two H₂O split into 4 H⁺, one O₂ and 4 e⁻; a hydrogen atom loses its electron and leaves a bare proton tagged H⁺; the H⁺ dots drop straight into the lumen, with no carrier crossing the membrane, and stay inside the closed sac. Small inset: rain falling straight into the dam's reservoir.

terms.meaning: H⁺ ke do naam: hydrogen atom se electron nikal jaaye toh sirf proton bachta hai, wahi hydrogen ion hai.

points.outside_book: Hydrogen atom mein ek proton aur ek electron hota hai, isliye H⁺ ko proton bhi kehte hain; barish ke paani ki tasveer.
points.answer: Nahi, water splitting ke H⁺ ko kisi carrier ko membrane ke paar nahi pahunchaana padta, kyunki paani lumen ki taraf tootta hai aur H⁺ seedhe lumen mein chhootte hain.
points.watch_out: Water splitting ke H⁺ stroma mein nahi, seedhe lumen mein chhootte hain; inhe membrane paar le jaane ki zaroorat nahi padti.

says: Doosri wajah dekho, jo electron ke safar mein hi chhupi hai.
Yaad karo, reaction centre se nikla electron sabse pehle primary acceptor leta hai.
Yeh primary acceptor membrane ki outer side par, yaani stroma ki taraf, hota hai.
Aap dhyaan do, kuch carriers sirf electron le jaate hain, jaise cytochrome B6f aur PC. Aise carrier ko electron carrier kehte hain, aur primary acceptor apna electron aise carrier ko nahi deta.
Woh electron aise carrier ko deta hai, jo electron ke saath ek H⁺ bhi utha leta hai. Aise carrier ko H carrier kehte hain.
Naam H carrier isliye hai, kyunki ek electron aur ek proton milkar ek hydrogen atom ke barabar hote hain. Yaani yeh carrier poora hydrogen dhota hai.
Dekho, H carrier ko electron ke saath H⁺ bhi chahiye. Toh woh yeh H⁺ kahan se uthata hai, stroma se ya lumen se?
H carrier yeh H⁺ stroma se uthata hai, kyunki electron lete waqt woh membrane ki stroma wali taraf hota hai.
Figure mein yahi H carrier PQ hai. Aap dekho, do electron aur stroma ke do H⁺ lekar woh PQH₂ ban jaata hai.
Phir PQH₂ membrane ke andar khiskta hua inner side ke electron carrier, cytochrome B6f, tak pahunchta hai.
Electron carrier sirf electron leta hai, H⁺ nahi. Isliye bacha hua H⁺ membrane ki inner side, yaani lumen, mein chhoot jaata hai.
Yahi B6f ke paas lumen ki taraf jaata H⁺ ka woh teer hai, jise humne figure mein yaad rakha tha.
Dam ki tasveer mein yahi pump hai, jo neeche ki nadi se paani uthakar deewaar ke peeche daal deta hai.
Yahan H⁺ kam wali jagah stroma se zyada wali jagah lumen mein ja raha hai, jo dhalaan ke ulta hai. Toh is ulte safar ki energy kahan se aati hai?
Is ulte safar ki energy electron ke apne safar se aati hai. Yaad karo, Z scheme mein electron neeche ki taraf jaate hue energy chhodta tha. Usi energy ka ek hissa yahan kaam aata hai.
Toh doosri wajah yeh hai: jab electrons photosystems se guzarte hain, tab protons membrane ke paar pahunchaaye jaate hain. Yeh protons stroma se lumen mein jaate hain.
Ab aap sochoge, cyclic raaste mein na paani tootta hai, na NADPH banta hai. Toh wahan ATP kaise banta hai?
Cyclic raaste mein ATP isliye banta hai, kyunki wahan bhi electron PQ aur B6f se hokar P700 par lautta hai. Is raaste mein bhi H⁺ lumen mein pahunchte rehte hain.
points.screen: Same section, the first cause now quiet: the primary acceptor on the stroma face hands electrons to PQ, while cytochrome B6f and PC are tagged as carriers of electrons only; PQ picks up two H⁺ from the stroma, becomes PQH₂, slides through the membrane to cytochrome B6f, releases the H⁺ into the lumen while the electrons go on to PC. Inset: the dam's pump lifting river water behind the wall. Then a dotted cyclic loop from P700 through PQ and B6f back to P700 drops H⁺ into the lumen the same way, with no water splitting and no NADPH.

terms.meaning: Aisa carrier jo sirf electron le jaata hai, H⁺ nahi, jaise cytochrome B6f aur PC.
Aisa carrier jo electron ke saath H⁺ bhi le jaata hai; electron + proton = ek hydrogen atom.

points.outside_book: Figure ka H carrier PQ hai, jo do electron aur stroma ke do H⁺ lekar PQH₂ banta hai aur B6f par H⁺ lumen mein chhodta hai; is ulte safar ki energy Z scheme ke downhill electron transfer se aati hai; cyclic raaste mein bhi electron PQ aur B6f se guzarta hai, isliye wahan bhi H⁺ lumen mein jaate hain.
points.answer: H carrier H⁺ stroma se uthata hai, kyunki electron lete waqt woh stroma ki taraf hota hai; H⁺ ke stroma se lumen tak ulte safar ki energy electron ke apne downhill safar se aati hai; cyclic raaste mein bhi electron PQ aur B6f se guzarta hai, isliye H⁺ lumen mein jaate hain aur ATP banta hai.
points.watch_out: H carrier H⁺ ko stroma se uthata hai aur lumen mein chhodta hai, ulta nahi; electron carrier H⁺ nahi le jaata.

says: Ab hum teesri wajah par aate hain, jo electron ke safar ke aakhri kadam par milti hai.
PS I ke acceptor se electrons Fd ke raaste FNR tak aate hain, yaani NADP reductase enzyme tak.
Yeh enzyme membrane ke us chehre par laga hai, jo stroma ki taraf hai. Isi chehre ko stroma side kehte hain.
Jab koi molecule electrons paa leta hai, toh uski chemical haalat badal jaati hai. Jaise yahan NADP⁺ electrons paakar NADPH ban jaata hai.
Molecule ke is tarah electrons paane ko reduction kehte hain. Iska ulta, electrons dena, oxidation hai, jaisa aapne paani ke saath dekha.
Par is badlav ke liye sirf electrons kaafi nahi hain. Ek H⁺ bhi chahiye: NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH.
Dekho, electrons Fd se aate hain, aur enzyme bas unhe NADP⁺ se jodne mein madad karta hai.
Enzyme stroma ki taraf laga hai, isliye yeh H⁺ bhi stroma se hi liye jaate hain.
Yaad karo ki gradient andar ke H⁺ aur bahar ke H⁺ ka fark hai.
Yeh H⁺ lumen mein gaya hi nahi, stroma mein hi NADPH ke saath jud gaya. Ruko, pehle khud socho: phir bhi isse gradient kaise badhta hai?
Aapne socha hoga ki fark sirf andar badhane se nahi, bahar ghatane se bhi badhta hai.
Gradient isliye badhta hai, kyunki stroma ke H⁺ NADPH banne mein kharch ho gaye. Isse bahar H⁺ kam reh gaye.
Socho, dam ke neeche ki nadi se kisaan nahar mein paani nikaal lein. Tab deewaar ke dono taraf ka fark aur badh jaata hai.
Toh teesri wajah yeh hai: NADP⁺ ki reduction ke liye zaroori protons bhi stroma se hataaye jaate hain.
Aap dhyaan do, yahan H⁺ ek taraf se doosri taraf le jaaya nahi gaya. Woh stroma mein hi kharch hua.
points.screen: Same section, earlier causes quiet: electrons come from PS I through Fd to FNR on the stroma side; a 'reduction' tag appears as NADP⁺ gains electrons, and NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH forms there; one stroma H⁺ dot is taken up and disappears from the stroma, while the lumen count is untouched. Inset: farmers drawing water from the river below the dam into a canal.

terms.meaning: Membrane ka woh chehra jo stroma ki taraf hai.
Molecule ka electrons paana; yahan NADP⁺ electrons paakar NADPH banta hai; iska ulta, electrons dena, oxidation hai.

points.outside_book: Kisaan ki nahar ki tasveer; NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH ka hisaab pehle script mein aa chuka hai.
points.answer: Gradient andar aur bahar ke H⁺ ka fark hai, isliye stroma ke H⁺ NADPH banne mein kharch hone se bahar H⁺ kam reh jaate hain aur fark badh jaata hai, chahe yeh H⁺ lumen mein gaye hi nahi.
points.watch_out: Aksar samjha jaata hai ki NADP⁺ ki reduction H⁺ ko lumen mein le jaati hai; asal mein woh stroma ke H⁺ kharch karti hai, unhe membrane paar nahi le jaati.

says: Ab teeno wajahon ko hum ek saath ginte hain, do paani ke molecules se shuru karke.
Do H₂O se chaar electron, chaar H⁺ aur ek O₂ bane. Yeh chaar H⁺ seedhe lumen mein gaye.
Wahi chaar electron aage do PQ par chadhe. Do PQ ne stroma se chaar H⁺ uthaye aur do PQH₂ bane. Yeh chaar H⁺ bhi lumen mein chhoote.
Aakhir mein wahi chaar electron do NADP⁺ ko do NADPH banate hain. Har NADPH ne stroma ka ek H⁺ liya, toh stroma se do H⁺ aur ghate.
Aap in teen wajahon ki ginti jodo: lumen mein chaar aur chaar, yaani aath H⁺ jude.
Stroma se chaar aur do, yaani chhe H⁺ ghate.
Dekho, lumen mein aath H⁺ jude, par stroma se sirf chhe ghate. Yeh dono ginti barabar kyun nahi hain?
Yeh dono ginti barabar isliye nahi hain, kyunki paani ke chaar H⁺ stroma se aaye hi nahi. Aur NADPH ke do H⁺ lumen mein gaye hi nahi.
Yeh ginti sirf ek O₂ banne tak ki hai. Light jab tak milti rahe, yeh ginti baar-baar judti rehti hai, aur andar-bahar ka fark badhta jaata hai.
points.screen: A counting board beside the same section, filling row by row: 2 H₂O → 4 H⁺ into the lumen; 2 PQ → 4 H⁺ from stroma into lumen; 2 NADP⁺ → 2 NADPH taking 2 H⁺ from the stroma. Tally at the end: lumen +8 H⁺, stroma −6 H⁺, for one O₂; the 4 water H⁺ and the 2 NADPH H⁺ glow to show why the two tallies differ.
points.outside_book: Ek O₂ par H⁺ ki ginti (lumen mein 8 jude, stroma se 6 ghate) aur dono gintiyon ke barabar na hone ki wajah teeno wajahon ko jodkar nikala gaya hisaab hai.
points.answer: Do H₂O (ek O₂) par lumen mein 4 (water splitting) + 4 (PQ) = 8 H⁺ jude, aur stroma se 4 (PQ) + 2 (NADPH) = 6 H⁺ ghate; dono ginti barabar nahi kyunki paani ke 4 H⁺ stroma se nahi aaye aur NADPH ke 2 H⁺ lumen mein nahi gaye.
points.watch_out: Lumen mein jude aur stroma se ghate H⁺ ki ginti barabar nahi hoti, kyunki water ke 4 H⁺ stroma se nahi aaye, aur NADPH ke 2 H⁺ lumen mein nahi gaye.

says: Toh aap dekh rahe ho ki teeno wajahon ka nateeja ek hi hai. Chloroplast ke andar stroma mein protons ki ginti ghatti hai, aur lumen mein protons jama hote jaate hain.
Aisa isliye hota hai, kyunki teeno kaam ek hi disha mein chalte hain. Water splitting aur PQ lumen mein H⁺ daalte hain, aur PQ aur NADP⁺ ki reduction stroma se H⁺ nikaalte hain.
Isse thylakoid membrane ke aar-paar proton gradient ban jaata hai.
Aap dhyaan do, yeh fark thylakoid ki membrane ke aar-paar hai, chloroplast ki bahari deewaar ke aar-paar nahi.
H⁺ ki zyada maatra ka ek aur asar bhi hai. Aapne nimbu chakha hoga, uska ras khatta lagta hai, kyunki usmein H⁺ bahut zyada hote hain.
Koi ghol kitna acidic, yaani khatta, hai, yeh hum pH naam ke scale se naapte hain. Saaf paani ka pH 7 hota hai, aur acidic ghol ka 7 se kam.
Aksar hum sochte hain ki zyada H⁺ matlab zyada pH, par aisa nahi hai. H⁺ jitne zyada hote hain, pH utna kam hota hai.
Toh ab aap batao, lumen mein H⁺ jama hone par uske pH ka kya hoga?
Lumen mein H⁺ jama hone par uska pH ghat jaata hai, kyunki wahan H⁺ zyada ho gaye. Lumen ke pH ki yeh kami naapi bhi ja sakti hai.
points.screen: Same section: arrows from the three causes point the same way, two filling the lumen and two emptying the stroma; the lumen now crowded with H⁺ dots, the stroma sparse; the thylakoid membrane glows as the boundary, while the chloroplast's outer envelope stays dim. Beside it a pH scale with lemon juice at the low end and pure water at 7; a lumen marker slides toward the lower pH.

terms.meaning: Ghol kitna acidic (khatta) hai, yeh naapne ka scale; saaf paani 7, acidic ghol 7 se kam; H⁺ zyada toh pH kam.

points.outside_book: Nimbu ka ras aur pH scale: saaf paani ka pH 7, acidic ghol ka 7 se kam.
points.answer: Lumen mein H⁺ jama hone par uska pH ghat jaata hai, kyunki H⁺ jitne zyada hote hain, pH utna kam hota hai.
points.watch_out: Zyada H⁺ ka matlab kam pH hai, zyada nahi; aur gradient thylakoid membrane ke aar-paar hai, chloroplast ki bahari deewaar ke aar-paar nahi.

says: Humne itni mehnat se H⁺ ko lumen mein jama hote dekha. Par sirf H⁺ jama karne se toh ATP abhi tak nahi bana.
Toh sawaal uthta hai ki hum is proton gradient mein itni dilchaspi kyun le rahe hain?
Proton gradient mein hum itni dilchaspi isliye lete hain, kyunki isi gradient ke tootne se ATP banta hai.
Yahan tootne ka matlab hai dono taraf ke H⁺ ke fark ka kam ho jaana. Isi ko breakdown of this gradient kehte hain.
Aksar lagta hai ki gradient tootne par protons khatam ho jaate hain, par aisa nahi hai. Woh bas zyada wali taraf se kam wali taraf laut aate hain.
Lumen ke H⁺ membrane paar karke stroma mein waapas jaate hain. Yeh aapke gubbare ki hawa jaisa hai, jo munh khulte hi bahar aati hai.
Par humne dekha tha ki band thaili ki membrane H⁺ ko andar roke rakhti hai. Toh yeh H⁺ bahar nikalte kahan se hain?
Yeh H⁺ ek khaas raaste se hi bahar nikalte hain, jo membrane ke aar-paar faila hai. Baaki membrane unhe kahin se nikalne nahi deti.
Trans ka matlab aar-paar hai. Jo raasta membrane ke ek taraf se doosri taraf tak faila ho, use transmembrane kehte hain.
Dam mein bhi paani sirf deewaar ki nali se girta hai. Ab hum is transmembrane raaste ko kholte hain.
points.screen: Same section with the crowded lumen; H⁺ dots begin moving back toward the stroma, but only through one channel that spans the membrane from side to side, while the rest of the membrane stays closed. Inset: a balloon's air rushing out of its mouth, then the dam's single pipe through the wall.

terms.meaning: Dono taraf ke H⁺ ke fark ka kam hona; protons khatam nahi hote, laut aate hain.
Membrane ke ek taraf se doosri taraf tak faila hua; trans = aar-paar.

points.outside_book: Gubbare ki hawa ki tasveer.
points.answer: Proton gradient mein hum isliye dilchaspi lete hain kyunki isi gradient ke tootne se, yaani lumen ke H⁺ ke ek transmembrane raaste se stroma mein lautne se, ATP banta hai; baaki membrane H⁺ ko nikalne nahi deti.
points.watch_out: Gradient tootne ka matlab protons ka nasht hona nahi; woh sirf zyada wali taraf (lumen) se kam wali taraf (stroma) laut aate hain.

says: Yeh transmembrane raasta usi ATP synthase mein hai, jise humne figure ki daayi taraf dekha tha. ATP synthase enzyme ke do hisse hain.
Iska pehla hissa thylakoid membrane ke andar dhansa hua hai. Yeh membrane ke aar-paar ek channel, yaani nali, banata hai.
Isi dhanse hue hisse ko CF₀ kehte hain. Iska channel hi woh transmembrane channel hai, jiski hum baat kar rahe the.
Naam mein C chloroplast ko batata hai. Aisi hi machine mitochondria mein bhi hoti hai, jise aap aage respiration mein dekhoge.
Ab roz ki ek baat yaad karo. Kamre ke kone mein agarbatti jalao, toh khushboo zyada wali jagah se kam wali jagah apne-aap phail jaati hai.
Kisi cheez ke is tarah zyada wali jagah se kam wali jagah apne-aap phailne ko diffusion kehte hain.
Par H⁺ par charge hai, isliye woh membrane ki charbi jaisi lipid parat se seedhe nahi nikal paata.
CF₀ ka channel use raasta deta hai. Dekho, H⁺ is raaste se apni dhalaan ke saath, zyada se kam ki taraf, beh jaata hai.
Yahan H⁺ ek protein raaste ki madad se paar jaata hai. Woh dhalaan ke saath jaata hai, isliye alag se energy nahi lagti.
Is tarah madad lekar, dhalaan ke saath paar jaane ko facilitated diffusion kehte hain. Facilitated ka matlab hai madad paaya hua.
Toh CF₀ ek transmembrane channel hai, jo membrane ke aar-paar protons ka facilitated diffusion karata hai.
ATP synthase ka doosra hissa thylakoid membrane ki outer surface par, stroma ki taraf, ubhra hua hai. Isi ubhre hue hisse ko CF₁ kehte hain.
Humne figure mein dekha tha ki ATP isi CF₁ ke paas banta hai. Toh bana ATP kahan milega, lumen mein ya stroma mein?
Bana ATP stroma mein milega, kyunki CF₁ stroma ki taraf ubhra hua hai.
Dam ki tasveer mein CF₀ deewaar ki nali aur turbine hai, aur CF₁ upar laga generator.
points.screen: Enlarged ATP synthase on the same thylakoid membrane: first the embedded part forming a channel across the membrane, then its name CF₀; H⁺ dots pass through CF₀ from lumen to stroma while the lipid layer elsewhere keeps them out. Inset: incense smoke spreading from a room's corner, tagged diffusion. Then the CF₁ head bulging out on the stroma side, with a new ATP appearing in the stroma. Closing overlay: CF₀ = pipe and turbine, CF₁ = generator.

terms.meaning: ATP synthase ka membrane mein dhansa hissa, jo H⁺ ke liye membrane ke aar-paar channel banata hai.
ATP synthase ka stroma ki taraf ubhra hua hissa.
Kisi cheez ka zyada wali jagah se kam wali jagah apne-aap phailna.
Protein raaste ki madad se, dhalaan ke saath, bina alag energy lagaye membrane paar jaana; facilitated = madad paaya hua.

points.outside_book: CF mein C = chloroplast, aur aisi hi machine mitochondria mein bhi hoti hai (respiration mein aage); H⁺ par charge hone se woh lipid parat se seedhe nahi nikalta; agarbatti ki khushboo se diffusion ki tasveer; CF₁ stroma ki taraf hai, isliye ATP stroma mein milta hai.
points.answer: Bana ATP stroma mein milta hai, kyunki CF₁ stroma ki taraf ubhra hua hai.
points.watch_out: CF₀ membrane mein dhansa channel hai aur CF₁ stroma ki taraf ubhra sir; CF₁ lumen ki taraf nahi hota, aur H⁺ CF₀ mein dhalaan ke saath (lumen se stroma) behte hain.

says: Humne dekha ki H⁺ CF₀ se bahkar stroma mein laut aate hain. Par H⁺ toh bas beh rahe hain, toh ATP jodne ki energy kahan se aayegi?
ATP jodne ki energy H⁺ ke isi bahne se aati hai, kyunki dhalaan ke saath bahte H⁺ energy chhodte hain.
Gubbare se nikalti hawa ko yaad karo. Woh aapke haath ko dhakka deti hai, kyunki bahti hawa mein energy hoti hai.
Ab ek protein ko socho. Protein ek lambi chain hai, jo mudkar ek khaas teen-dimensional banawat mein rehti hai.
Gradient ke tootne se itni energy milti hai ki ATP synthase ke CF₁ particle ki yeh banawat badal jaati hai.
Protein ki is teen-dimensional banawat ko conformation kehte hain. Isi banawat ke badalne ko conformational change kehte hain.
Jab H⁺ CF₀ se guzarte hain, toh uska ek hissa turbine ki tarah ghoomta hai. Yahi ghoomna CF₁ ki shape badalta hai.
Socho, CF₁ ke andar ATP banane ki teen jagahein hain. Shape badalne par koi jagah ADP aur Pᵢ ko pakadti hai. Koi unhe dabakar jod deti hai, aur koi bana ATP chhod deti hai.
Is badlav se enzyme energy-packed, yaani energy se bhare, ATP ke several molecules bana deta hai. Several yaani ek nahi, kai molecules.
Aap dhyaan do, ATP mein ADP aur Pᵢ jude hain, aur electron is jodne mein kahin shaamil nahi hai.
points.screen: The same enlarged ATP synthase: a protein chain folds into its three-dimensional shape; H⁺ passing through CF₀ turns part of it like a turbine; the CF₁ head changes shape; its three sites in turn hold ADP + Pᵢ, press them together and release ATP; several ATP molecules gather in the stroma, with no electron anywhere near the machine. Inset: air from a balloon pushing against a hand.

terms.meaning: Protein ki teen-dimensional banawat (conformation) ka badalna.

points.outside_book: Protein ek lambi chain hai jo mudkar teen-dimensional banawat banati hai; H⁺ ke CF₀ se guzarne par uska ek hissa turbine ki tarah ghoomta hai aur CF₁ ki shape badalta hai; CF₁ mein ATP banane ki teen jagahein hain jo baari-baari ADP aur Pᵢ ko pakadti, jodti aur ATP chhodti hain; gubbare ki hawa ke dhakke ki tasveer.
points.answer: ATP jodne ki energy H⁺ ke dhalaan ke saath CF₀ se bahne, yaani gradient tootne, se aati hai; yahi energy CF₁ ki shape badalkar ATP ke several molecules banwaati hai.
points.watch_out: ATP electron se nahi banta; woh ADP aur Pᵢ ke judne se banta hai, aur iski energy gradient tootne par CF₁ ki shape badalne se milti hai.

says: Ab poori baat ek jagah samet lo. Yaad karo, H carrier aur cytochrome B6f milkar H⁺ ko stroma se lumen mein pahunchaate hain. Yaani woh H⁺ ko kam wali taraf se zyada wali taraf le jaate hain.
Dhalaan ke ulta chalne mein energy lagti hai. Jaise aapke ghar ki motor bijli lekar paani chhat ki tanki tak chadhati hai. Yahan yeh energy light se excited electron ke safar se aati hai.
Energy lagakar H⁺ ko is tarah kam wali taraf se zyada wali taraf pahunchaane wale ko proton pump kehte hain.
Toh dekho, chemiosmosis ke liye chaar cheezein chahiye: ek membrane, ek proton pump, proton gradient aur ATP synthase.
Yaad karo, membrane H⁺ ko ek taraf roke rakhti hai, jaise dam ki deewaar paani ko.
Thylakoid thaili ke andar ki wahi jagah, jise hum ab tak lumen keh rahe the, thylakoid lumen kehlaati hai.
Electron ke safar ki energy se protons membrane ke paar pump hote hain. Isse thylakoid lumen mein H⁺ ki oonchi maatra, yaani gradient, ban jaati hai.
ATP synthase ka channel protons ko membrane ke paar waapas diffuse hone deta hai.
Is lautne se itni energy nikalti hai ki ATP synthase enzyme sakriya ho jaata hai. Phir woh ATP banne ki reaction ko catalyse karta hai, yaani tezi se karata hai.
points.screen: The whole thylakoid section: first PQ as H carrier and cytochrome B6f lift H⁺ from the stroma into the lumen, and a pump icon appears on them (inset: a home motor pushing water up to a roof tank). Then a four-item checklist lights one by one: membrane; proton pump; proton gradient in the thylakoid lumen; ATP synthase. H⁺ come back out through ATP synthase.

terms.meaning: Energy lagakar H⁺ ko kam wali taraf se zyada wali taraf pahunchaane wala.
Thylakoid thaili ke andar ki jagah, yaani lumen.

points.outside_book: Thylakoid mein proton pump ka kaam H carrier (PQ) aur cytochrome B6f milkar karte hain; ghar ki motor se chhat ki tanki tak paani chadhane ki tasveer.
points.watch_out: Pump karna dhalaan ke ulta hai aur energy maangta hai; CF₀ se lautna dhalaan ke saath hai aur isi se ATP ki energy milti hai.

says: Humne dekha ki membrane H⁺ ko lumen mein roke rakhti hai, aur H⁺ sirf CF₀ ke raaste laut paate hain.
Ab socho, phir aage badhenge: agar thylakoid membrane mein chhote-chhote ched ho jaayen, toh kya hoga? Light aur electron ki daud chalti rahe, toh bhi kya ATP banega?
Membrane mein ched hone par ATP nahi banega, kyunki H⁺ CF₀ ke bajay chedon se laut jaayenge. Tab lumen mein fark ban hi nahi paayega.
Electron tab bhi carriers mein daud sakte hain, lekin aap dekhoge ki unki mehnat ATP tak nahi pahunchegi.
Dam ki deewaar mein daraar ho, toh paani turbine ghumaaye bina beh jaata hai, aur bijli nahi banti.
Isliye yaad karo, chemiosmosis ko membrane, pump, gradient aur ATP synthase, chaaron chahiye. Inmein se ek bhi na ho, toh chemiosmosis nahi chalta.
points.screen: The same section with tiny holes appearing in the membrane: H⁺ leak back to the stroma through the holes instead of CF₀, the lumen stops filling, and an ATP counter stays empty while electrons still run along the carriers. Inset: a crack in the dam wall, water bypassing the turbine.
points.outside_book: Membrane mein ched hone par gradient na banna aur ATP na banna, sochne ka sawaal jo book se aage hai.
points.answer: Membrane mein ched hone par ATP nahi banega, kyunki H⁺ CF₀ ke bajay chedon se stroma mein laut jaayenge, lumen mein H⁺ ka fark nahi banega, aur ATP synthase ko chalaane wala bahaav hi nahi milega; electron daud sakte hain par unki energy ATP tak nahi pahunchegi.
points.watch_out: Galat vichaar: electron daudte rahein toh ATP banta hi rahega. Yeh galat hai, kyunki ATP electron ki daud se seedhe nahi, H⁺ ke CF₀ se lautne se banta hai; fark na bane toh ATP nahi banta.

says: Ab poori kahani hum shuru se ek baar jodte hain.
Light se excited electron PS II se chalkar PQ, B6f aur PC ke raaste PS I tak pahunchta hai. Phir woh Fd aur FNR se NADP⁺ tak jaata hai.
Raaste mein teen kaam hote hain. Water splitting lumen mein H⁺ deti hai, aur PQ stroma se H⁺ uthakar lumen mein chhodta hai. NADPH banne mein stroma ke H⁺ kharch hote hain.
Nateeja yeh hai ki lumen mein H⁺ zyada aur pH kam ho jaata hai. Stroma mein H⁺ kam reh jaate hain.
Phir H⁺ CF₀ ke channel se stroma mein laut aate hain. CF₁ ki shape badalti hai, aur ADP aur Pᵢ se ATP banta hai.
Toh ab aaj ke sawaal par lauto, jo humne shuru mein poochha tha. Electron ADP ko chhoota hi nahi, phir uski daud ATP kaise bana deti hai?
Electron ki daud ATP isliye bana deti hai, kyunki woh pehle H⁺ ka fark banati hai. Phir us fark ka lautna ATP synthase ko chalaata hai.
Ek baat aur dekho. Yeh ATP aur electrons ke safar se bana NADPH, dono membrane ki stroma wali taraf hi bante hain.
Wahin stroma mein inka turant istemaal hota hai. Wahan ek reaction hawa ki CO₂ ke carbon ko organic molecule mein pakka jodti hai. Yahi reaction aage sugars banati hai.
CO₂ ke carbon ke is tarah pakka jud jaane ko fixing CO₂ kehte hain.
Jeevit cell mein naye molecule banane wali aisi reaction ko biosynthetic reaction kehte hain. Bio yaani jeevan, aur synthesis yaani banana.
Yeh reactions kaise chalti hain, yeh hum aage dekhenge. Abhi aap bas itna jaan lo ki unhe ATP se energy aur NADPH se electrons milte hain.
Dam ki bijli taaron se ghar pahunchkar kaam aati hai. Waise hi ATP aur NADPH stroma mein sugar banane ke kaam aate hain.
points.screen: The whole thylakoid section retold in order: the electron path PS II → PQ → B6f → PC → PS I → Fd → FNR → NADP⁺ lights first, then the three H⁺ causes, the crowded low-pH lumen, H⁺ returning through CF₀ and ATP leaving CF₁. The opening question card returns and is answered. Then ATP and NADPH drift into the stroma toward a space where CO₂ enters for sugar making. Inset: power lines carrying the dam's electricity to houses.

terms.meaning: Hawa ki CO₂ ke carbon ko ek organic molecule mein pakka jod dena.
Jeevit cell mein naye molecule banane wali reaction; bio = jeevan, synthesis = banana.

points.outside_book: Biosynthetic naam ke hisse (bio = jeevan, synthesis = banana); dam ki bijli ghar tak pahunchne ki tasveer.
points.answer: Electron ki daud ATP isliye banati hai kyunki woh pehle lumen aur stroma ke beech H⁺ ka fark banati hai, aur us fark ka CF₀ se lautna ATP synthase ko chalaata hai.
points.watch_out: ATP aur NADPH stroma mein bante aur wahin kaam aate hain, lumen mein nahi; CO₂ fix karne wali reactions inhe istemaal karti hain, khud light se seedhe nahi chalti.

parts.bridge: ATP aur NADPH ab stroma ki taraf taiyaar hain aur O₂ bhi bani hai; agle heading mein dekhenge ki light reaction ke in teen products mein se kaun bahar nikal jaata hai aur kaun sugar banane ke kaam mein lagta hai.
parts.title: Chemiosmotic Hypothesis

parts.goal: Ab ATP aur NADPH ki taiyaar supply ko sugar synthesis se jodenge, aur jaanenge ki fixed carbon ka pehla pehchaana product kya hai.

says: Ab ATP aur NADPH ki taiyaar supply ko sugar synthesis se jodenge, aur jaanenge ki fixed carbon ka pehla pehchaana product kya hai.
Stromal reactions ko ATP ki energy aur NADPH ki reducing power milti hai, jaisa hum abhi jod chuke hain.
Light reaction ke teen products ki destinations alag karo: O₂ chloroplast se diffuse karke bahar jaati hai, jabki ATP aur NADPH sugars banane ke kaam aate hain.
Kya released oxygen bhi sugar synthesis ki energy supply hai?
Dekho, energy aur reducing-power supplies ATP aur NADPH hain; O₂ ka outward diffusion unse alag destination hai.
Yahaan do sawaal follow karenge: sugar synthesis light ki supply par kaise depend karti hai, aur CO₂ ka carbon sabse pehle kis product mein milta hai?
points.screen: Realistic chloroplast cutaway: thylakoids se ATP aur NADPH ki arrows surrounding stroma mein; O₂ ki separate arrow chloroplast boundary ke bahar. Saath do question labels: light dependence aur first fixation product.

says: Sugar banane wala yeh hissa biosynthetic phase hai; bio jeevan se aur synthesis naye substances banane se juda hai.
Is phase ko ATP aur NADPH ke alawa CO₂ aur H₂O chahiye; water ka formula hum pehle samajh chuke hain.
Indirect light dependence ko light-on → light-off → light-on comparison se samjho.
Light band karte hi sugar synthesis turant kyun nahi rukti?
Dekho, pehle se available ATP aur NADPH kuch der reactions support karte hain, lekin unki renewed supply na milne par synthesis ruk jaati hai.
Light wapas milne par light reactions supplies dobara banati hain aur sugar synthesis resume hoti hai.
Yeh sequence dikhata hai ki biosynthetic phase ko light seedhe nahi chalati, lekin light-reaction products ki availability usse jodkar rakhti hai.
points.screen: Usi chloroplast ke neeche three-part timeline: light on par supplies aur sugar formation; light off par remaining ATP/NADPH ke saath brief continuation, phir stop; light return par renewed supplies aur restart.

terms.meaning: Photosynthesis ka organic substances, khaaskar sugars, banane wala hissa.

says: Socho, bakery ko roz ingredients aur charged battery packs ki delivery milti hai.
Delivery van ruk jaaye, toh counter par rakhe ingredients aur battery packs se kuch aur batches ban sakte hain.
Kya van rukte hi ovens ka kaam usi second band hona zaroori hai?
Dekho, bacha stock kuch der kaam chalata hai, lekin stock khatam hone par fresh delivery ke bina production rukega.
Yahaan bakery stromal biosynthesis hai, delivery light reactions ki supply hai, aur bacha stock available ATP aur NADPH hai.
Light lautne se supply renew hona van ki delivery dobara shuru hone jaisa hai.
points.screen: Bakery mein limited ingredient trays aur charged packs se do remaining batches; neeche matching chloroplast timeline mein available ATP/NADPH ghatte hue, phir supply restart.
points.outside_book: Limited-stock bakery analogy indirect dependence samjhane ke liye added hai.
points.answer: Bakery = stromal biosynthesis; delivery = light-reaction supply; remaining stock = available ATP aur NADPH; delivery restart = illumination se renewed supply.
points.watch_out: ATP aur NADPH ko long-term stored reserves ya bakery ingredients ke chemically identical equivalents na samjhein.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: kya biosynthetic phase ko dark reaction kehna misleading naam, ya misnomer, ho sakta hai?
Light-off timeline ko reason banao; kya darkness ne synthesis ko start kiya tha?
Dekho, darkness is phase ki requirement nahi hai, aur light-reaction supplies khatam hone par yeh rukta hai, isliye dark naam night-only process ka galat impression deta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki light reactions din mein aur dark reactions sirf raat mein chalti hain, par asal mein yeh directly aur indirectly light-dependent kaamon ka distinction hai.
points.screen: Light-off timeline par brief continuation aur later stop highlighted; uske saamne label: directly light-driven nahi, light-reaction products par dependent.
points.answer: Dark naam misleading hai kyunki darkness required nahi; ATP aur NADPH ki renewed supply ke liye biosynthesis indirectly light reactions par depend karti hai.
points.watch_out: Brief continuation ko unlimited darkness mein synthesis ka proof na samjhein; remaining supplies limited hain.

says: Ab ATP aur NADPH ka detailed use samajhne ke liye overall sugar formation ke andar carbon ka raasta dhoondhenge.
Humne CO₂ aur H₂O se carbohydrate formation ka overall account dekha tha; ab wahi carbohydrate composition (CH₂O)ₙ se likh sakte hain.
Is notation mein n batata hai ki CH₂O ka composition ratio kitni baar liya gaya; glucose ke liye n six hai.
Kya overall equation bata deti hai ki incoming carbon sabse pehle kis compound mein gaya?

says: Calvin aur Bassham ki labelled carbon wali khoj hum pehle mil chuke hain; ab us investigation ka specific result dekho.

says: Agla sawaal tha: kya har plant mein initial CO₂ fixation ka pehla stable product PGA hi hota hai?
Wide plant surveys mein doosra group mila, jiska first stable product four-carbon organic acid oxaloacetic acid tha.
First stable product fixation ke baad pehla stable compound hai, sirf overall final sugar nahi.

Jin plants ka initial stable product three-carbon PGA hai, unka initial route C₃ pathway kehlaata hai.
Jinmein four-carbon oxaloacetic acid pehla stable product hai, unka initial route C₄ pathway kehlaata hai.
In names ke three aur four kya ginte hain?
Dekho, yeh first stable product ke carbon atoms ginte hain, incoming CO₂ molecules ya carbon lene wale starting molecule ke carbons nahi; associated differences aage dekhenge.
points.screen: Survey ka simple two-branch comparison: C₃ → PGA → 3 carbon positions; C₄ → oxaloacetic acid → 4 carbon positions. Column heading: initial first stable fixation product.

terms.meaning: CO₂ ke carbon ko organic molecule mein jodna; pehle fixing CO₂ ke roop mein samjha tha.
CO₂ ke carbon ko plant ke organic substances ka hissa banana.
Four-carbon organic acid; C₄ route ka initial first stable fixation product.
Initial fixation ke baad milne wala pehla stable compound.

points.watch_out: First stable product ko carbon receive karne wale starting molecule se confuse na karein.

says: Ab poora connection jodo: light reactions ki O₂ bahar diffuse hoti hai, aur ATP tatha NADPH stromal sugar synthesis ko support karte hain.

Carbon ka raasta dhoondhne par algal tracer studies mein three-carbon PGA pehla identified product mila.

says: Ab PGA ki pehchaan se aage badhkar CO₂ lene wala starting molecule khojenge, aur uske carbon count ko product ke carbon count se jodenge.

PGA mein teen carbon atoms hain, jaisa hum abhi pehchaan chuke hain.
Scientists ka sawaal bhi yahi tha: ek-carbon CO₂ judne ke baad three-carbon PGA mile, toh starting molecule mein kitne carbons honge?
Teen mein se ek ghataakar two-carbon starting molecule sochna natural hai, lekin kya product ke sirf ek molecule ko ginana kaafi hai?

says: Experiments ka unexpected answer five-carbon ketose sugar ribulose bisphosphate, ya RuBP, tha.
Incoming CO₂ isi starting sugar molecule se judta hai.
RuBP mein five-carbon skeleton aur do alag positions par phosphate groups hote hain; bisphosphate naam in do phosphate groups ko batata hai.
Ketose sugar ka matlab aisa sugar hai jiski open-chain form mein ketone group hota hai.
Ketone group mein ek carbon oxygen se double bond banata hai aur dono taraf carbon se juda hota hai.
Five-carbon starting molecule se three-carbon product kaise milega?
Dekho, carbon conservation sahi rehti hai; humein reaction ke saare product molecules ka hisaab jodna hoga.
points.screen: Usi stromal picture mein RuBP ka five-carbon molecular model; terminal positions par do phosphate tags aur open-chain structure mein internal C=O highlight.

terms.meaning: Five-carbon sugar jiske do alag positions par phosphate groups lage hote hain; incoming CO₂ isse judta hai.
Sugar jiski open-chain form mein ketone group hota hai.

points.outside_book: Ketone group ki basic bonding aur bisphosphate naam ke parts ki explanation clarity ke liye jodi gayi hai.

says: Agar tumne two-carbon acceptor guess kiya, toh ghabraao mat; scientists ne bhi pehle yahi possibility sochi thi.
Unhone many years ek 2-carbon compound, yaani do carbon atoms wale compound, ko acceptor ke roop mein dhoondhne mein lagaaye.
Bahut experiments ke baad five-carbon RuBP ki identity mili.
Galat guess itna convincing kyun laga?
Aksar log sochte hain ki three-carbon PGA milne par starting acceptor two-carbon hi hoga, par asal mein ek product molecule ka size poore reaction ka carbon total nahi hota.
Dekho, saare product molecules ginne par five-carbon RuBP ka hisaab milta hai.
points.screen: Research timeline: three-carbon PGA se two-carbon acceptor ka initial hypothesis; multiple experimental observations ke baad five-carbon RuBP ki confirmed identity.

terms.meaning: Aisa compound jiske ek molecule mein do carbon atoms hon.

says: Ab ek RuBP molecule ke five carbon counters lo, aur incoming CO₂ ka ek carbon counter unke saath jodo.
Balanced equations mein atoms conserve hote hain, jaisa hum overall photosynthesis equation mein dekh chuke hain.
Total six carbons ko do three-carbon groups mein baanto; har group ek PGA molecule ka carbon skeleton dikhata hai.
Carbon ledger hua: 5 + 1 = 3 + 3.
Kya six-carbon total ka matlab ek stable six-carbon product hi milega?
Dekho, total carbon count six hai, lekin stable products do PGA molecules hain; ek molecule ka size aur saare products ka total alag quantities hain.
points.screen: Pehle wale RuBP model ke five carbon counters mein ek labelled CO₂ carbon judta hai; wahi six counters do PGA groups mein bantte hain, neeche 5 + 1 = 3 + 3.
points.outside_book: Do PGA molecules ka carbon ledger agle heading ki reaction ko samajhne ke liye yahaan briefly khola gaya hai.

says: Socho, packing table par five toy blocks pehle se rakhe hain aur courier ek aur block laata hai.

Yahaan starting five blocks RuBP ke carbons hain, naya block CO₂ ka carbon hai, aur two parcels do PGA molecules hain.

parts.bridge: Ab acceptor aur products ka carbon hisaab mil gaya; Calvin cycle mein dekhenge ki reaction kaise chalti hai aur RuBP dobara kaise taiyaar hota hai.
parts.title: The Primary Acceptor of CO₂

parts.goal: Ab RuBP se shuru karke carbon aur energy ka poora Calvin-cycle hisaab jodenge, aur dekhenge ki sugar banne ke saath acceptor dobara kaise milta hai.

says: Ab RuBP se shuru karke carbon aur energy ka poora Calvin-cycle hisaab jodenge, aur dekhenge ki sugar banne ke saath acceptor dobara kaise milta hai.

Lekin RuBP use hota rahe, toh agle CO₂ ko kaun receive karega?
Dekho, Calvin aur co-workers ne dikhaya ki pathway RuBP ko regenerated, yaani use hone ke baad dobara taiyaar, karta hai; isi renewal se cycle close hoti hai.
Calvin pathway wahi Calvin cycle hai, jo chloroplast ke stroma mein carbon se carbohydrate banane ka kaam karta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki yeh sirf C₃ plants mein hota hai, par asal mein C₄ aur doosre photosynthetic plants bhi Calvin pathway use karte hain.
Initial fixation ka first stable product alag ho sakta hai, lekin Calvin pathway unka shared biosynthetic route hai.

terms.meaning: Use hone ke baad dobara banaya gaya.
Calvin cycle ka doosra naam; photosynthetic plants ka shared carbon-assimilation pathway.

says: Ab in teen stages ke alag jobs aur unke beech carbon ka connection pehchaano.

Carbon bahar product mein bhi jaayega aur cycle mein wapas bhi aayega; dono branches ko alag ginenge.
Energy ka sawaal kya rahega?
Dekho, har stage par note karenge ki ATP aur NADPH kahaan lagte hain, taaki carbon balance ke saath energy bill bhi clear rahe.

says: Carboxylation mein CO₂ ka carbon RuBP se judkar stable organic intermediate, yaani aage ki reactions mein use hone wale carbon compound, mein pahunchta hai.
Ek RuBP aur ek CO₂ follow karo: RuBP ke five aur CO₂ ka one carbon milkar six-carbon total dete hain, jisse two three-carbon 3-PGA molecules bante hain.
3-PGA wahi pehle pehchaana PGA hai; iska naam 3-phosphoglyceric acid hai.
Yeh reaction RuBP carboxylase se catalysed hoti hai, yaani enzyme reaction ko tez chalne mein madad karta hai.
Is enzyme ka fuller naam RuBP carboxylase-oxygenase, ya RuBisCO, kyun hai?

Abhi hum CO₂ wala route follow kar rahe hain; O₂ wali reaction ka nateeja aage dekhenge.

terms.meaning: CO₂ jodkar uske carbon ko organic compound mein incorporate karne ka step.
Pathway mein banne wala relatively stable carbon compound jo agle reactions mein use hota hai.
Pehle khole PGA ka naam: three-carbon 3-phosphoglyceric acid.
Enzyme ki madad se reaction ka tez chalna.
RuBP ki CO₂ wali carboxylation aur O₂ wali oxygenation, dono catalyse kar sakne wala enzyme.
RuBP ke saath O₂ ki alag reaction catalyse karne ki ability.

says: Ab reduction stage mein two 3-PGA molecules ko carbohydrate intermediate banne ki direction mein process karte hain.

Isliye per CO₂ molecule fixed, yaani ek CO₂ jodne ke account mein, reduction ka bill two ATP aur two NADPH hai.
Is stage ka carbohydrate intermediate triose phosphate hai: triose mein tri three batata hai, isliye har molecule mein three carbons hain.

Dekho, glucose ko six carbons chahiye, isliye six CO₂ fixation aur six turns ka net carbon account ek glucose equivalent deta hai.
Turn ka matlab yahaan ek CO₂ fixation ke saath cycle ka ek accounting round hai; har round ka direct product free glucose nahi hota.
points.screen: Ussi stromal picture mein second region add ho: two 3-PGA → two triose phosphates. Har three-carbon molecule ke paas 1 ATP aur 1 NADPH input; combined reduction bill 2 ATP + 2 NADPH.

terms.meaning: Har ek CO₂ ko pathway mein incorporate karne ke hisaab se.
Three-carbon sugar phosphate jo reduction ke baad carbohydrate synthesis aur regeneration ko feed karta hai.
Cycle ke accounting rounds; har turn mein ek CO₂ fix hota hai.

points.outside_book: Reduction se milne wale triose phosphate ka carbon count aur glucose-equivalent output ko direct free-glucose production se alag kiya.

says: Ab regeneration mein carbohydrate intermediates ka ek hissa rearrange hokar RuBP pool dobara banata hai.
CO₂ acceptor wahi molecule hai jo incoming CO₂ receive karta hai; Calvin cycle mein yeh RuBP hai.
RuBP formation ki phosphorylation ke liye har fixed CO₂ ke account mein ek additional ATP chahiye.
Regeneration crucial kyun hai?
Dekho, RuBP renew na ho toh available acceptor pool ghat jaayega, aur ATP tatha NADPH hone ke bawajood next CO₂ fixation continue nahi hogi.
Renewal cycle ko uninterrupted, yaani agla round acceptor ki kami se ruke bina, chalne deta hai.
points.screen: Stromal picture mein third region add ho: triose-phosphate return branch → rearranged carbon skeletons → RuBP. Regeneration par 1 ATP per fixed CO₂ input aur ADP output.

terms.meaning: Incoming CO₂ ko receive karne wala molecule; yahaan RuBP.
Agle round ke liye zaroori supply ki kami se ruke bina.

says: Ab three CO₂ ka batch lo, taaki output aur regeneration dono ka carbon ledger poore molecules mein dikhe.
Three RuBP ke fifteen carbons aur three CO₂ ke three carbons milkar eighteen carbons dete hain: six 3-PGA molecules.
Reduction mein six ATP aur six NADPH use hokar six three-carbon triose phosphates ka pool banta hai; carbon total eighteen hi rehta hai.
Inmein one triose phosphate ka three-carbon equivalent net carbohydrate output hai, aur five triose phosphates ke fifteen carbons regeneration mein jaate hain.
Yeh fifteen carbons three five-carbon RuBP molecules ko restore karte hain, jisme three additional ATP lagte hain.
Cycle ne fifteen-carbon acceptor pool wapas banaya, toh net gain kitna hua?
Dekho, incoming three CO₂ ke three carbons ke barabar net output mila, jabki starting RuBP pool replenish ho gaya.
Six CO₂ par yahi ledger double hota hai: two net triose-phosphate equivalents ke six carbons ek glucose equivalent provide karte hain.
points.screen: Ussi stromal pathway ke beside spacious carbon ledger: 3 × 5C + 3 × 1C → 6 × 3C; phir branch 1 × 3C net output aur 5 × 3C → 3 × 5C regenerated RuBP. Quiet pathway ke sirf relevant branch par highlight.
points.outside_book: Three-CO₂ batch ka explicit carbon ledger: six triose phosphates mein se one net equivalent aur five equivalents se three RuBP regeneration.

says: Socho, workshop mein reusable mould se har batch ki shape banayi jaati hai.
Product banne ke baad mould ko clean, reassemble aur ready karne mein bhi energy lagti hai.
Manager sirf product-making electricity gine aur mould reset ka bill bhool jaaye, toh total production cost kam dikhegi.
Yahaan reusable mould RuBP ke acceptor role ko samjhata hai, product-making cost reduction ki ATP–NADPH demand hai, aur reset cost regeneration ka ATP hai.
Reset ko optional kyun nahi chhod sakte?
Dekho, agla batch ready mould maangta hai, waise hi next CO₂ fixation available RuBP maangti hai; isliye regeneration ka energy bill total mein judega.

points.outside_book: Reusable mould analogy se acceptor renewal aur separate regeneration cost samjhayi.

Figure ke teen stage numbers ko jobs se jodo: carbon entry, carbohydrate intermediate formation, aur acceptor renewal.

Plant ki ek sugar jisme assimilated carbon ja sakta hai.

Sucrose ke roop mein carbon growing parts tak transport ho sakta hai, aur starch ke roop mein temporarily store ho sakta hai.
Ek leaf apne se door growing root ko carbon material kaise de sakti hai?

says: Ab ek CO₂ ka total bill jodo: reduction ke two ATP aur regeneration ka one ATP milkar three ATP hue; NADPH two hi lage.

Dekho, cyclic phosphorylation wahi ATP-only cyclic photophosphorylation hai, isliye yeh extra NADPH banaye bina ATP demand poori karne mein help kar sakti hai.

says: Ek glucose equivalent ke six carbons ke liye six CO₂ aur six turns chahiye; turn wahi ek CO₂-fixation accounting round hai.

says: Poora order phir jodo: RuBisCO carboxylation mein RuBP ke five aur CO₂ ke one carbon se two three-carbon PGA banata hai.

parts.title: The Calvin Cycle

parts.goal: Ab shared Calvin cycle tak C₄ plants ki carbon delivery follow karenge, aur samjhenge ki leaf ki special anatomy is delivery ko kaise support karti hai.

says: Ab shared Calvin cycle tak C₄ plants ki carbon delivery follow karenge, aur samjhenge ki leaf ki special anatomy is delivery ko kaise support karti hai.

Anatomy pehchaanne ke baad process ke chaar steps follow karenge: initial carbon fixation, four-carbon compound ki delivery aur CO₂ release, three-carbon remainder ki return, aur acceptor regeneration.
C₄ oxaloacetic acid wahi pehle pehchaana four-carbon first stable product hai, aur dono groups ka shared Calvin cycle bhi hum jaan chuke hain.
C₄ plants dry tropical regions, yaani garam ilaakon ki paani-kam conditions, ke liye adapted ho sakte hain.
Inka main biosynthetic pathway, yaani organic substances banane wala connected reaction route, Calvin cycle hi hai.
Phir C₃ plants se inka farq kya hai?
Aksar log sochte hain ki C₄ plants Calvin cycle use nahi karte, par asal mein unki initial carbon capture aur delivery alag hai, sugar-making Calvin cycle shared hai.
points.screen: Realistic maize leaf se internal tissue tak zoom; four-carbon oxaloacetic acid entry route ke aage shared Calvin-cycle symbol. Side par chaar numbered steps: fixation, delivery/release, return, regeneration.

terms.meaning: Pehle pehchaana four-carbon oxaloacetic acid; C₄ initial fixation ka first stable product.
Garam tropical ilaake jahaan paani ki availability kam ho sakti hai.
Organic substances banane wali connected reactions ka route.

says: C₄ plants ki paanch khas baatein jodo: special leaf anatomy, higher-temperature tolerance, high light intensities par achchha response, photorespiration ka practically absent hona, aur greater biomass productivity.
Leaf anatomy leaf ke andar tissues aur cells ka arrangement hai.
Photorespiration RuBisCO ki O₂ wali activity se shuru hone wala route hai, jisme fixed carbon aur energy ka loss hota hai; iska detail agle heading mein kholenge.
RuBisCO ki CO₂ aur O₂, dono wali activities hum pehle pehchaan chuke hain.
Productivity of biomass ka matlab fixed time mein naya plant material banne ki rate hai.
Photorespiration ko C₄ plants mein absent kyun maana jaata hai?
Dekho, inka carbon-delivery system RuBisCO ke paas CO₂ badhata hai, jisse photorespiration bahut strongly suppress hoti hai.
Pehle anatomy samjhenge, phir delivery route se in features ka connection jodenge.
points.screen: Maize leaf ke paas paanch features: internal tissue ring, warmth, strong light, suppressed photorespiration aur biomass gain.

terms.meaning: Leaf ke andar tissues aur cells ki banawat aur arrangement.
RuBisCO ki O₂ wali activity se shuru carbon aur energy kharch karne wala route.
Ek fixed time mein naye plant material ke production ki rate.

says: Teacher-prepared vertical sections mein ek C₃ leaf aur ek C₄ maize leaf ko microscope se compare karo.
Vertical section leaf ki upper se lower surface tak thickness ko expose karne wala thin cut hai.
Mesophyll wahi internal photosynthetic tissue hai, jise hum pehle locate kar chuke hain.
Kya dono leaves mein mesophyll ka arrangement aur veins ke aas-paas ke cells ek jaise hain?
Dekho, maize mein vein ke around prominent large-cell ring dikhti hai, aur uske baahar mesophyll arranged hota hai.
C₃ reference section mein yahi characteristic C₄ ring organisation nahi milti.
Mesophyll ke layers bhi compare karo, lekin har C₃ leaf mein ek jaisi layer differentiation maan lena sahi nahi hai.
points.screen: Side-by-side realistic microscopic C₃ reference aur maize vertical sections; vein-surrounding cells aur outer mesophyll highlighted.

terms.meaning: Leaf ki upper se lower surface tak thickness dikhane wale thin cuts.

points.outside_book: C₃ leaves mein mesophyll differentiation ki variation ko clarify kiya.
points.answer: Maize section mein characteristic prominent sheath ring aur surrounding mesophyll organisation milti hai; har C₃ leaf ka mesophyll identical nahi hota.
points.watch_out: Ek reference C₃ section ki layering ko sabhi C₃ species ka compulsory pattern na maano.

says: Socho, ek central stand ke chaaron taraf flowers ki wreath, yaani gol maala, lagi hai.
Har flower central stand ko gherne wale ring ka hissa hai; isi surrounding arrangement ko leaf mein pehchaano.
Vascular bundles leaf ki veins ke andar water aur food transport karne wale xylem–phloem groups hain.
In bundles ko gherne wale cells bundle sheath cells kehlaate hain.
Typical C₄ leaf mein particularly large sheath cells ka wreath-like arrangement Kranz anatomy kehlaata hai; Kranz ka meaning wreath hai.
Yahaan central stand vascular bundle hai, aur flower-ring large bundle sheath cells hain.
Kranz naam leaf ke baahari shape ko kyun nahi batata?
Dekho, naam internal cells ki bundle ko gherne wali arrangement se aaya hai, poori leaf ki outline se nahi.
points.screen: Circular flower wreath ke saath realistic maize vein cross-section; centre vascular bundle aur surrounding large bundle sheath cells matched.

terms.meaning: Xylem aur phloem ke transport groups jo leaf veins ke andar hote hain.
Vascular bundle ko chaaron taraf gherne wale cells.
Typical C₄ leaf mein vascular bundle ke around large sheath cells ki wreath-like organisation.

points.outside_book: Xylem–phloem ka basic transport role prerequisite ke roop mein khola.
points.answer: Central stand vascular bundle hai; flower wreath surrounding large bundle sheath cells ka spatial arrangement hai.
points.watch_out: Wreath sirf arrangement samjhati hai; bundle sheath cells flowers nahi hain aur unke biochemical functions analogy se explain nahi hote.

says: Bundle sheath ki ring mein several layers ho sakti hain, lekin multiple layers compulsory nahi hain.
In cells mein numerous chloroplasts, thick walls aur cells ke beech intercellular spaces ki absence khas features hain.
Intercellular spaces neighbouring cells ke beech ki khaali jagahen hain.
Walls ko impervious to gaseous exchange kehte hain, yaani gases ka freely aar-paar jaana strongly restricted hota hai.
Gas escape restrict karna useful kyun hoga?
Dekho, sheath ke andar delivered CO₂ retain hogi, aur numerous chloroplasts ke stromal reactions us carbon ko use kar sakenge.
Chloroplast stroma ka sugar-making role hum pehle samajh chuke hain.
points.screen: Wahi realistic maize section enlarged: tightly packed sheath cells, many chloroplasts, thick walls aur restricted outward CO₂ arrows.

terms.meaning: Paas ke cells ke beech ki khaali jagahen.
Gases ke freely cross karne ko strongly restrict karne wala.

says: Ab maize aur sorghum ke teacher-prepared thin leaf sections mein Kranz anatomy identify karo.
Pehle vascular bundle locate karo, phir uske around large chloroplast-rich sheath aur baahar mesophyll cells trace karo.
Mesophyll cells wahi leaf ke internal photosynthetic tissue ke cells hain, jinhe hum pehle pehchaan chuke hain.
Sorghum ke section mein bhi kya isi organisation ko dhoondhoge?
Dekho, dono named C₄ examples mein bundle, surrounding specialised sheath aur outer mesophyll ka relationship match karna hai.
Result sirf green cells dekhna nahi, balki unki organised positions pehchaanana hai.
points.screen: Maize aur sorghum prepared sections; har sample mein vascular bundle → bundle sheath → mesophyll ke nested highlights.

says: Ab aas-paas ki diverse plant species ki leaves collect karke labels lagao, aur teacher se unke thin vertical sections prepare karwao.
Microscope mein har section ka vascular bundle, sheath ke cells aur mesophyll distribution record karo.
Observation sheet mein maize aur sorghum ko characteristic Kranz organisation wale samples ke roop mein rakho.
Kya kisi bhi bundle sheath ka milna C₄ hone ka proof hai?
Dekho, C₃ leaves mein bhi bundle sheath ho sakti hai; characteristic large, chloroplast-rich Kranz organisation ko pehchaanana zaroori hai.
Sirf external leaf shape ya plant ka garam jagah ugna pathway establish nahi karta; internal organisation zyada informative evidence deti hai.
points.screen: Filled observation sheet: maize—Kranz; sorghum—Kranz; reference C₃ section—characteristic Kranz absent; saath corresponding tissue micrographs.
points.outside_book: C₃ plants mein bhi bundle sheath ho sakne ki clarification di.
points.answer: Sections mein specialised Kranz arrangement compare karna hai; sheath ki simple presence ya external morphology decisive nahi hai.
points.watch_out: Har vein-surrounding sheath ko Kranz kehne se C₃ leaves ko bhi galti se C₄ classify kar doge.

says: Bazaar ka bhutta maize crop se aata hai, aur jowar ki roti sorghum ke grain se banti hai.
In dono food crops ki leaves mein yahi microscopic organisation carbon delivery support karti hai.
Higher-temperature tolerance aur strong-light performance inki farming se jude physiological features hain.
Kya in crops ko har environment mein sabse zyada yield milegi?
Dekho, actual harvest paani, light aur doosri growing conditions par bhi depend karta hai, isliye C₄ adaptation universal yield guarantee nahi hai.
points.screen: Bhutta aur jowar ki roti ke saath maize aur sorghum fields; crop leaves se Kranz tissue ka connection.
points.outside_book: Food connections aur C₄ advantage ko universal yield guarantee se alag kiya.

says: Ab Figure 11.9 ka Hatch and Slack Pathway chaar steps mein follow karenge: initial fixation, four-carbon compound ki delivery aur CO₂ release, three-carbon return, aur acceptor renewal.
Hatch and Slack Pathway C₄ carbon-capture aur delivery route ka doosra naam hai.
Yeh cyclic process hai, kyunki starting acceptor dobara available hota hai; acceptor renewal ka logic Calvin cycle mein bhi dekha tha.
Dono cycles ka acceptor kya same hoga?
Dekho, Calvin cycle ka acceptor RuBP tha, lekin is initial delivery cycle ka acceptor ab alag pehchaanenge.
points.screen: Realistic adjacent mesophyll aur bundle sheath cell cutaways; chaar numbered steps: fixation, delivery/release, return, renewal.

terms.meaning: C₄ plants ka initial carbon-capture, delivery aur acceptor-renewal route.
Aisa connected reaction route jisme starting working component dobara milta hai.

says: Mesophyll mein primary acceptor phosphoenol pyruvate, ya PEP, three-carbon molecule hai.
PEP carboxylase, ya PEPcase, initial carbon fixation catalyse karta hai, aur four-carbon OAA banta hai.
OAA wahi pehle khola oxaloacetic acid hai; carbon ledger three plus one equals four hai.
Figure mein incoming inorganic carbon HCO₃⁻, bicarbonate, ke roop mein dikhta hai; PEPcase isi form ko use karta hai.
Is typical C₄ arrangement ke mesophyll cells mein PEPcase hai, lekin RuBisCO nahi hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki C₄ ka primary acceptor four-carbon hoga, par asal mein PEP three-carbon acceptor aur OAA four-carbon product hai.
Acceptor aur enzyme ko alag kyun rakhna hai?
Dekho, PEP carbon skeleton receive karta hai, jabki PEPcase reaction catalyse karta hai; enzyme ko three-carbon acceptor kehna galat hoga.
points.screen: Wahi mesophyll cutaway: atmospheric CO₂ se HCO₃⁻, phir PEP ke three carbon beads mein one carbon add hokar OAA four beads; PEPcase label.

terms.meaning: C₄ initial fixation ka three-carbon acceptor molecule.
PEP aur bicarbonate se initial four-carbon product banane wali reaction ka enzyme.
Pehle pehchaane oxaloacetic acid ka short name; four-carbon first stable product.
Bicarbonate ion; PEPcase ko milne wala inorganic carbon ka form.

points.outside_book: PEPcase ke actual bicarbonate substrate ko figure ke HCO₃⁻ label se clarify kiya.

says: Mesophyll mein OAA se malic acid ya aspartic acid jaise other four-carbon compounds bante hain.
In four-carbon organic acids ko yahaan C₄ acids keh rahe hain; yeh captured carbon neighbouring bundle sheath cells tak transport karte hain.
Sheath mein inka breakdown CO₂ release karta hai aur three-carbon remainder deta hai; CO₂ nikalne ko decarboxylation kehte hain.
Four carbons ka balance kahaan gaya?
Dekho, four-carbon carrier se one-carbon CO₂ aur three-carbon remainder milta hai, isliye four equals one plus three rehta hai.
points.screen: Same cells par OAA se malic/aspartic acid; four-carbon cargo sheath mein enters, phir one-carbon CO₂ aur three-carbon remainder mein splits.

terms.meaning: Four-carbon compounds jo captured carbon mesophyll se bundle sheath tak pahunchate hain.
Yahaan four-carbon organic acid jo carbon delivery mein kaam aata hai.
Kisi compound se CO₂ release hona.

says: Ab three-carbon remainder bundle sheath se mesophyll mein return hota hai, jahaan usse PEP dobara banta hai.
Regeneration ka meaning wahi starting working molecule ka renewal hai; yahaan renew hone wala acceptor PEP hai, RuBP nahi.
Kya return route ko free carbon recycling samajh sakte hain?
Dekho, PEP renewal energy maangta hai, isliye carbon-concentrating system ka extra energy bill bhi hota hai.
Typical C₄ accounting mein har delivered CO₂ ke liye two additional ATP equivalents lagte hain.
points.screen: Same cell cutaways par three-carbon return arrow aur mesophyll mein PEP regeneration; energy badge: +2 ATP equivalents per CO₂.
points.outside_book: PEP regeneration ka extra cost: two ATP equivalents per CO₂; commonly ATP-to-AMP conversion ki energy accounting.

says: Bundle sheath mein released CO₂ ab C₃ ya Calvin pathway ko feed karti hai.
RuBisCO ke through RuBP carboxylation ka reaction hum pehle follow kar chuke hain.
Yahaan CO₂ preliminary four-carbon compound ki decarboxylation se milti hai; Calvin cycle CO₂ release nahi karti.
Calvin cycle mein fixed carbon ka net output triose phosphate sugar ke roop mein nikalta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki initial C₄ fixation hi sugar-making Calvin cycle ko replace karti hai, par asal mein yeh usse concentrated CO₂ supply karti hai.
Do fixation events ko kyun alag pehchaanenge?
Dekho, pehla event carbon delivery ke liye capture karta hai, aur doosra shared Calvin pathway mein carbohydrate formation ko feed karta hai.
points.screen: Same bundle sheath cutaway par four-carbon compound se released CO₂ ka arrow chloroplast stroma ke Calvin-cycle inset tak; net triose-phosphate output alag highlighted.
